Here’s how to cancel your Frontier flight and see the refund/fees before you commit:

1) Go to your booking on Frontier
- Open: https://www.flyfrontier.com  
- At the top, click “My Trip / Check-in”.  
- Choose “Last Name + Confirmation Code”.  
- Enter:
  - Last name: Reeves  
  - Confirmation code: BK-F94402-20260902 (if the site rejects this, check your Frontier email for a shorter 6‑character code; use that one instead).  
- Click “Search” to pull up your trip.

2) Open the cancel/change options
- On the trip page, look for a button or link such as:
  - “Manage Trip”, “Change/Cancel”, or “Cancel Flight”.  
- Click that to see options.

3) See refund / credit and fees (before finalizing)
- Frontier will usually show you a summary screen before you confirm:
  - Any cancellation fee (or a line showing “no fee” if applicable).  
  - Whether you’ll get:
    - A refund to original form of payment, or  
    - A Frontier travel credit / voucher (common on low‑fare tickets).  
  - The total amount you’d receive back.
- Read this screen carefully.  
- If the offer/fees don’t look good, do NOT click the final “Confirm” or “Cancel Trip” button—use Back or close the page instead.

4) If you want to proceed with cancellation
- Once you’re satisfied with the refund/credit and fee:
  - Click the final confirmation button (often “Confirm Cancellation” or similar).  
- You should see a confirmation page and get an email with:
  - Cancellation confirmation, and  
  - Details of any refund or travel credit.

If you’re using the Frontier mobile app instead:
1. Open the app → log in (or use “Find My Trip” with last name + confirmation code).
2. Tap your trip under “Trips” or “My Flights”.
3. Tap “Manage Trip” or equivalent, then “Cancel”.
4. Review the refund/fees summary screen; only tap the final confirm button if you agree.

If you’d like, you can paste what you see on the refund/fees screen (without personal info), and I can help you interpret what Frontier is offering before you hit confirm.</action>
